property_summary: For any positive timestamp, a fallback call carrying exactly 10 ether must succeed and record that timestamp in pastBlockTime(); the mutant makes the subsequent `block.timestamp > pastBlockTime` check always fail, so every properly funded call reverts and pastBlockTime never advances.
change_summary: Move the assignment `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` to the top of the function body so it executes even when a subsequent require reverts, changing the observable value after a failed call.
